note: The core is bsnes v115 (GPL-3.0-only) with this repository's patches (GPL-3.0-only) and integration (MIT); the program is distributed under the GPL version 3. Inside bsnes, and compiled in: nall and its other libraries by byuu (ISC), SameBoy by Lior Halphon (MIT), which plays the Game Boy in a Super Game Boy, and upstream's databases of cartridge boards and of verified games. libco is this repository's own (waterbox/libco.c, MIT), with the aarch64 switch of ares's libco (ISC). The package contains no game, no Super Game Boy cartridge or boot ROM and no coprocessor firmware: the user supplies them.
